vlm-safety.title: Safety alignment for vision-language models
vlm-safety.focus: Evaluate the professor's text/image safety seesaw hypothesis. Use frozen-model measurement to validate evidence before training extensions; v3 code is available and its results are pending.
vlm-safety.question: Under a controlled intervention, does improving image-conditioned safety reduce text-only safety, or can both improve once prompt, comprehension, judge and benign-utility effects are separated?
pdf_folders: Continual safety via sample based GD
next_steps: Review v1/v2 and available v3 code against cross-modal safety literature; distinguish a static modality gap from an intervention-induced seesaw. Treat v3 results as pending until its outputs are available.
Complete blinded human judge calibration using the existing analysis-plan thresholds; report disagreements and missing labels.
Freeze a new run manifest with dataset, model, prompt and judge revisions; key label caches by response and rubric hashes.
Replace E-full with a key-phrase-matched text control, and add read-back/comprehension measurements at the same image cap.
Add benign controls before interpreting refusal gains as safety gains; retain smoke and pilot runs as separate datasets.
Run the preregistered scenario-aware analysis only after the judge gate passes; label all new analyses exploratory.
Use the research council for source-grounded synthesis after primary-paper ingestion; keep unsupported pilot claims out of the manuscript.
